name: pathofdev
description: Path of Dev: an RPG around your Claude Code work: XP, levels, loot and a pixel pet, drawn in a band above the prompt.

minWords.title: Words to grade a prompt
minWords.description: A prompt you type earns XP from Haiku's grade once it has this many words, pasted text included. Shorter ones, slash commands and prompts you didn't type go ungraded. Only the scores leave your machine, never the prompt.

animations.title: Celebrations
animations.description: How loot drops, level-ups and finished missions play in the band: full animations (the band grows for the big ones, epic and legendary chime), reduced (one still frame in the band's own rows, no sound), or off.

toasts.title: Reward toasts
toasts.description: One toast for everything a prompt, a commit, a mission or a level-up earned: the mission, its XP, level-ups, drops and gold. Off, the band still celebrates and names the latest gain.

server.title: Server
server.description: Which server the mod plays on: your own local save (default), the local dev sandbox in ~/.pathofdev-dev for trying out band styles, XP and celebrations (start it with PATHOFDEV_DEV=1 pnpm --filter @pathofdev/server start), or online, the public server at the Online server URL (closed beta: /pathofdev login signs you in with GitHub). PATHOFDEV_HOME, when set, picks the home for either local one. Each server keeps its own queue of events. /pathofdev server says which one you play on, and /pathofdev server play, dev or online switches it here.

serverUrl.title: Online server URL
serverUrl.description: The https address of the online server, used when Server is online. Anything but a plain https origin plays on https://api.pathof.dev. Online, the mod never sends a repo's name, only opaque keys. /pathofdev login keeps the game token it gets in the mod's own store and sends it to this origin alone, over https; /pathofdev logout revokes it.
